From combat to a confirmed reward.

Read the Claude handoff guide ↗

1 · Server verifies play2 · Signs match receipt3 · Caps & deduplicates4 · Company sends reward

Eligible matches last at least 60 seconds with 10 valid actions and 5 valid hits, and two distinct human wallets. Offline AI games do not qualify. A signed receipt is reserved once, payouts are batched after a match, and wallet balances change only after blockchain confirmation. Server checks must also detect collusion and farming.

Optional native SOL reward pool

The protocol also supports a separate, company-funded SOL pool: illustrative rates of 1 lamport per verified hit, 10 lamports per completion, and a 1,000-lamport daily player cap. This is separate from MNRG, with no automatic exchange rate. Tiny transfers require rent-valid recipient accounts and still incur network fees. Both pools are inactive until funded and configured.

A few things before you head out

The explorer’s field guide.

01 / Move. Aim. Make a little chaos.

Drag a finger anywhere on the stadium to steer your Monstar. Tap a spot to walk there. WASD and arrow keys also work. In Stadium duel, tap one of the four moves, or use keys 1–4. Hold Space for your primary move. Shift dashes out of danger. Auto repeats your primary move whenever you have energy and it is ready. You can toggle fullscreen above the move buttons.

02 / Better together.

In Wild expedition, lower a rival’s health to 35% or less (gold health bar). Get close and press E or CATCH. Captures always succeed when the rival is close enough and weak enough. Duplicate captures award extra experience and shards. Your three starter partners are already unlocked.

03 / Pick your challenge.

Stadium duel is a free head-to-head battle against AI: use energy-based moves, elemental strengths, shields, and team switching. Energy recovers over time. Ultimate moves unlock at level 3; shields unlock at level 2. Expedition has a steady flow of wild creatures. Survival arena spawns stronger waves as you clear them. Titan challenge pits you against a large, powerful guardian and its minions. Win by defeating the titan. Defeats and captures award experience and shards. Leveling up increases health and attack power. Buy permanent partner levels in Your journey.

04 / Your adventure, on your device.

This beta has AI opponents and local saves, with no online multiplayer. Phantom connection shares your public address after your approval. It does not mint NFTs or authorize payments. The separate devnet NFT workshop requests explicit transaction approval. SOL balances are read from Solana RPC and refreshed every 15 seconds while the wallet panel is open; errors are shown explicitly. Combat uses nonredeemable points only. Wallet-linked DNA is a local preview, not verified blockchain ownership. PocketMonstars uses original procedural pixel artwork and original creature designs. Sound can be switched on below.
